# Decision log template

> Copy this into a new file named `docs/log/YYYYMMDD_topic.md`, for example
> `20260314_drought_scoring_rubric.md`. The date goes first, in year-month-day order, so the
> files sort correctly by name. Do not sort your log folder by "date modified"; cloud sync
> changes those timestamps. Delete this blockquote when you copy.
>
> One file per decision or work session. Keep it short. The goal is that months from now, you
> or a collaborator can reconstruct what happened and why.

# Decision Log: [short title of the decision or session]

**Date:** [YYYY-MM-DD]
**Topic / folder:** [what this concerns, e.g. `data/drought_assay/`]
**Author:** [you, or "you + assistant"]

---

## What was done

[A few sentences. What did you actually do in this session? Which files did you create, change,
or analyze? Enough that someone could retrace it.]

## What was decided

[The decisions, as a short list. Be specific about the choice made and, briefly, why. Anchor to
stable IDs and canonical file names, not nicknames.]

- Decided [X] because [reason].
- Chose [file / value / threshold] over [alternative] because [reason].

## Numbers or results worth recording

[Any key values produced, with the source file they came from. Report groups separately if your
project requires it. If a number changed from a previous value, say so.]

| Result | Value | Source file |
|---|---|---|
| [what it is] | [value + units] | [`canonical_file.csv`] |

## To double-check later

[Anything you are unsure about, any assumption you made, any number that needs verifying, or any
follow-up. This is where you protect future-you from a quiet mistake.]

- [ ] [thing to verify]
- [ ] [follow-up task]

---

*Logged: [YYYY-MM-DD]*
